style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2, modern everyday setting, original people in present-day casual clothes. NO text, letters, numerals, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Communicate the specific meaning through clear actions and relationships, suitable for elementary-school readers and mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass greens, pale sky blues, warm earthy browns, plenty of ivory breathing room. No flat digital color blocks, no glossy shading, no 3D, no imitation of any named artist. Scene:
scene_prompt: Modern adult revisits an old childhood schoolyard many years later. Person gently touches a small faded child handprint preserved in a weathered clay tile on low wall, and holds a worn photograph showing the SAME wall, tree and tiny handprint when he was a child with friends. The present schoolyard quiet, old swing and large tree remain, friends long gone. A soft-edged recollection inset shows children happily pressing hands into wet clay at that same place years ago. Focus on faint surviving physical traces and old photo evoking vanished past, not fresh construction or current handprint-making. Warm reflective melancholy suitable for children, no readable writing or dates anywhere. Natural touch and photo grip, stable wall, tree rooted, swing safely unused. Landscape 3:2 graphite watercolor colored-pencil ivory paper, no letters numbers brands logos or watermarks.
alt: 成人重訪安靜的舊校園，拿著童年照片，輕摸矮牆上依稀可辨的小手印；回憶小景裡，孩子們曾在這裡留下手印。
